nodes.description: Contract owner address, set to msg.sender in constructor and used as recipient of the pump-rate share.
Monotonic game counter incremented on every startNewGame call.
Accumulated sum of all player contributions (msg.value).
Lock flag controlled by owner through updateLock; gates the fallback via notLock.
Staged ContractParam configuration written by owner via changeConfig.
Active ContractParam configuration used for pricing, winner thresholds and payout rate.
Dynamic array of participating players, truncated on each new game and during stopGame.
Deploys the contract, sets owner, seeds setConfig/curConfig and starts the first game.
Owner-only toggle of isLock that stops or restarts the game.
Owner-only private routine that distributes the whole balance evenly to all recorded players.
Owner-only transfer of the owner state variable to a non-zero address.
Owner-only payable configuration update of totalSize, singlePrice and pumpRate.
Private routine that increments gameIndex, applies pending config and clears addressArray.
Public view returning game index, active config, players, totalPrice and lock state.
Private payout routine selecting a winner with getRamdon and transferring owner/winner shares.
Private view computing a pseudo-random index from now, blockhash and player addresses.
Payable fallback that admits players, updates totalPrice and triggers gameResult when full.
Private view using extcodesize to reject contract callers.
Modifier enforcing msg.sender == owner on privileged functions.
Modifier enforcing isLock == false on the fallback entry point.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, player registration and winner selection.
Block timestamp (now) used inside the randomness computation and emitted in gameOverEvent.
totalPrice = totalPrice + msg.value; unchecked uint256 accumulation of player funds.
Loop of curPlayer.transfer(price) sending ETH to every stored player address.
owner.transfer(giveToOwn) paying the pump-rate share to the owner.
lastAddress.transfer(giveToActor) paying the remainder to the selected winner.
uint price = totalBalace / addressArray.length; division whose divisor can be zero.
uint giveToOwn = totalBalace * curConfig.pumpRate / 100; multiplication/division without overflow checks.
gameIndex++ on a uint32 counter, wrappable after 2^32 games.
uint index = uint(ramdon) % addressArray.length; modulo by a potentially zero length.
Winner index derived from keccak256 of now/blockhash and player list: predictable block-variable randomness.
_singlePrice * 1 finney scaling performed without overflow protection.
Constructor uint32 total size written into setConfig/curConfig.
Constructor uint256 single price scaled by 1 finney.
changeConfig uint32 total size staged into setConfig.
changeConfig uint256 single price staged into setConfig.
changeConfig uint8 pump rate staged into setConfig.
Address passed to transferOwnership and assigned to owner.
Boolean lock value passed to updateLock and written to isLock.
Address inspected by isNotContract through extcodesize.
Snapshot of address(this).balance used for the even distribution in stopGame.
Per-player payout computed as totalBalace / addressArray.length.
Current player address taken from addressArray inside the stopGame loop.
Loop counter over addressArray in stopGame.
Winner index in gameResult produced by getRamdon.
Winning address selected from addressArray in gameResult.
Contract balance snapshot used to split owner and winner shares.
Owner share computed as totalBalace * pumpRate / 100.
Winner share computed as totalBalace - giveToOwn.
Accumulated keccak256 pseudo-random seed in getRamdon.
Loop counter mixing player addresses into the random seed.
Result of the extcodesize assembly read in isNotContract.
Final index returned by getRamdon after the modulo operation.
